name: Digits
summary: Digits is AI-assisted accounting software priced per month with no setup fee: Essentials at $65 and Core at $100, with a $250 Pro plan listed as coming soon. Every tier lists bank, card and payroll connections to 12,000+ providers, automated reconciliation and live profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow statements. Digits states SOC 2 Type II compliance.

facts.text: Digits states that it is SOC 2 Type II compliant.
Additional entities are free up to 250 transactions a year, then start at $35 a month.
The pricing page offers a 30-day free trial and no setup fees, and notes that sales tax may apply depending on location.
The pricing page lists the ledger as drill-down from category to transaction, which is the closest it comes to naming a general ledger.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Marked most popular, for small and growing businesses

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Listed as coming soon. For businesses with internal finance teams

hiddenCosts: Additional entities cost $35 a month or more once they pass 250 transactions a year.
